Carbon dioxide is naturally present in the air. An increased amount of carbon dioxide in the air is
a cause of global warming.
Which row shows one way to increase and one way to decrease the amount of carbon dioxide in
the air?
increases carbon dioxide
decreases carbon dioxide
A
reduction in livestock farming
using electric cars
B
wind generation of electricity
using solar power
C
using hydrogen as a fuel
burning methane in power stations
D
using diesel vehicles
planting trees

options.label: A
options.text: reduction in livestock farming using electric cars

options.label: B
options.text: wind generation of electricity using solar power

options.label: C
options.text: using hydrogen as a fuel burning methane in power stations
